snippet.title: Stellaris: Season 10 | Announcement Trailer "Home"
snippet.description:
Season 10 marks the beginning of a new era for Stellaris!  

Start by instantly unlocking the exclusive Vipra the Vapor species portrait today. 

Soon, your civilization will roam the galaxy aboard colossal arkships in Nomads (Q2 2026), leaving behind the traditional borders that once limited your expansion. Continue in Willpower (Q4 2026), where the empire's ethics evolve into powerful ideologies that shape the fate of your people, before facing the ultimate test in the Scenario Packs (q4 2026) arriving later this year.

Season 10 on Steam - https://pdxint.at/StellarisS10
Season 10 on Microsoft - https://pdxint.at/StellarisS10MS
